sources.title: Risk of Performance Decrements and Adverse Health Outcomes Resulting from Sleep Loss, Circadian Desynchronization, and Work Overload
sources.used_for: Sleep and circadian context for evidence cards and explanations. Does not establish ASTRA's deviation thresholds, explain an individual's HRV, or validate scenario benefits.
sources.summary: NASA describes sleep loss, disrupted circadian timing, and environmental interference with sleep as concerns for crew performance. ASTRA uses this research context to explain why a sleep trend may merit review.
sources.content_locator: Opening article paragraphs and Human Research Roadmap links
sources.license_note: Attributed factual paraphrase and external link only. No NASA images, logos or full reports copied. See NASA media guidance; do not imply endorsement.

sources.title: Human System Risks
sources.used_for: Research risk taxonomy and contextual links for the science page and review findings. The catalog does not supply ASTRA telemetry or validate its unitless prototype signal categories.
sources.summary: NASA's catalog includes sleep, cardiovascular, muscle, bone, radiation, and cabin carbon dioxide risks. These categories frame ASTRA's research references; fictional daily readings and fixture-specific rules remain separate.
sources.license_note: Attributed factual paraphrase and external link only. No NASA images, logos or full reports copied. See NASA media guidance; do not imply endorsement.

sources.title: Risks of Human Spaceflight
sources.used_for: Mission context and limitations for the science page and illustrative sleep/exercise planning comparisons. No NASA effect size or clinical prediction is implemented from this page.
sources.summary: NASA organizes human-spaceflight risks around radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, gravity changes, and hostile or closed environments. Its overview includes sleep and fitness research, providing context rather than a personalized prediction model.
sources.content_locator: About Human Spaceflight Risks; sleep and fitness sections
sources.license_note: Attributed factual paraphrase and external link only. No NASA images, logos or full reports copied. See NASA media guidance; do not imply endorsement.
